[SWS_CRYPT_40913]
{DRAFT}
Sets of certificates
⌈
The function
ara::crypto::
x509::X509Provider::FindCertByDn
shall provide a set of all certificates that
match the attributes of parameter subjectDn. The function findCertByDn shall ignore
none-initialized attributes of parameter subjectDn for the search for certificates.
⌋
(RS_-
CRYPTO_02306)
